title: Dogs licking the blood off the street
html_source:
Expresses the fact that there were eye-witnesses during Emmet’s execution.
In Kings 21:19, the Lords directs Elijah to tell Arab, “In the place where the dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood, even thine.”
